title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 522 North Central Avenue in Phoenix, Arizona, as the "Ed Pastor Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 522 North Central Avenue in Phoenix, Arizona, as the "Ed Pastor Post Office."

summary.headline: A 2016 law renamed a Phoenix, Arizona post office after former congressman Ed Pastor.
summary.what_it_does: This law names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 522 North Central Avenue in Phoenix, Arizona, the "Ed Pastor Post Office." It is a commemorative naming measure and does not change how mail is handled or who can use the building. The official summary describes only the renaming.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 29, 2016.
